description:
World::entry_dispatch (src/compiler2/world.rs:1505-1510) returns a clone of the whole plan (matrix, graph, every guard) on each of four production reads: executable_facts.rs:489 (stores it), jobs/keying.rs:418 (only walks it), jobs/contract.rs:127-131 and jobs/semantic.rs:130-142 (clone only to satisfy the borrow checker around types_mut). World::guard_dispatch (world.rs:2108) clones a helper plan per guard reference per re-plan (jobs/dispatch.rs:181), and that clone is then embedded by value into every caller plan via PatternGuardExpr::Dispatch.

Priority 4 of the north star: equal reproduction preserves the allocation and performs no deep copies.

Change: the fact type becomes Rc<PatternDispatchPlan<Ty>>. FunctionDispatchMap<T> needs only Clone + PartialEq (dispatch.rs:32-34); Rc's pointer shortcut makes change detection cheaper, not different. Net lines about zero; deep copies per job read go to zero.

Signal: compiler2_entry_dispatch_recomputes_only_the_dependent_helper_blast_radius (drive_test.rs:17114) and canon double-compile equality stay green; --log-telemetry job trace on a guard-heavy fixture unchanged.
title: Plan facts are shared by Rc: no deep copy per fact read
